reviews.title: Not great….
reviews.text: This app has a few issues! Me and my sister love to draw and we both downloaded this app to improve our technique. This app is extremely glitchy, has too many adds, and is very hard to trace in. This app also had false advertising. One time I couldn’t even log into the app! The reason I gave this app two stars, is because, I managed to draw a few little cartoons that turned out good. The other generated cartoons were to hard to trace in! Developers, please help this app by, fixing the glitches, discarding a few adds, and making it way easier to draw in the lines like you advertised in many AR drawing app adds that intrigued me. These suggestions would improve this app A LOT. Thank you, and I hope you consider my concern.

So I attempted to press the X and move on but instead of getting off the ad since the X is so tiny  I pressed the ad and it took me to a website and it was very inappropriate and as I was getting off the website my phone started blasting a voice saying “your device has been caught doing illegal activities and your device has been disabled call the Apple support number to reactivate your device” and I’ve shown someone else and explained the whole situation while panicking because it isn’t everyday you hear this coming from your phone without doing anything and I noticed after every single audio it said not to power off your phone and why exactly would it say that? So I started turning off and turning back on the phone just to start off and to not make any mistake because I thought maybe something bad will happen if I power it off so I just turned it off and back on and when I did that it showed a file of an audio (not a real alert) and the person I asked to help me asked “did you download anything today?” And I said no because I didn’t and we soon figured out the ad was trying to scam us into calling them so I assume that it makes you download that audio automatically when you accidentally click on the ad and

reviews.title: Amazing to help you draw but not super appropriate
reviews.text: I’m almost 11 and I am really into drawing right now, so one of my friends told me about the app, and I immediately downloaded the app. I looked through all of the categories until I saw some really disturbing things like people putting the middle finger up and kissing. At first I ignored it, but that’s not all. There are adds every time you click on something. The adds look very sketchy, so when I accidentally clicked on one it took me too a very dangerous website and tried to make me pay money so that I could use it. But luckily my phone blocked it and told me it was dangerous. But the drawing part is amazing. I wouldn’t recommend the app for people that get really uncomfortable with the stuff that I talked about earlier. Thank you for reading this! Developers you need to fix this problem. I really wish that there was not this stuff

But then they updated the premium and now you have to buy premium to draw stuff from your own photos!! This made so sad and mad, but most of all, disappointed!! That was my favorite thing about this app! But they had to take it away!! People are way to greedy for money and they had to solve that by making others sad because they have to buy something that they loved/liked! This is so stupid! I have so much things I wanna draw from my phone! But guess what, I can't do that anymore because it cost money!! This broke my heart.

reviews.title: Used to be good
reviews.text: I used this before a little while ago when I was trying to draw something for school and I just came back to it to find out that now you have to pay for premium to be able to draw from your gallery which I find absolutely ridiculous. All these money, hungry companies can’t let people enjoy one thing without having to spend $10 a month. Technically you could do a three day trial, but if you don’t cancel it in time, it’ll just start charging you and if you do cancel it then you still have to pay money. It’s so dumb. Worst part is there’s no other AR drawing app that doesn’t make you pay for premium. Literally the only thing you can draw for free on this app are like brain rot. It’s horrible.
